_comment: End-to-end checks expected to fail until an app bug is fixed. 'check' is the full name the run prints ('suite: check'); 'platforms' (optional) limits an entry to some of darwin, win32, linux. Strict: a listed check that passes fails the run, so remove its entry in the PR that fixes the bug.

issues.check: open: the backup chooser is announced as a dialog
issues.reason: BackupChooserDialog has no role=dialog / aria-modal / label, so screen readers don't announce it (Settings and Save do)

issues.check: exports: Save panel: messages as pdf
issues.reason: On Windows python/main.py reads stdin as cp1252, so conversation names with emoji ("Lindqvists 🏔") reach the engine garbled: the export writes mangled file names and stops with an error partway (10 of 17 files as HTML, none as PDF)

issues.check: exports: Save panel: messages as html
issues.reason: On Windows python/main.py reads stdin as cp1252, so conversation names with emoji ("Lindqvists 🏔") reach the engine garbled: the export writes mangled file names and stops with an error partway (10 of 17 files as HTML, none as PDF)

issues.check: open: a backup in a folder named with accents and symbols opens
issues.reason: python/main.py reads stdin with the Windows code page (cp1252), so non-ASCII paths from Electron arrive garbled; test_rpc_contract.py has the engine-level xfail

issues.check: macos: dmg: the notarization ticket is stapled
issues.reason: build/notarize.js submits without --wait and never staples, so Gatekeeper needs to be online on first launch

issues.check: macos: zip: the notarization ticket is stapled
